title: 🔆🔅Images show the Israeli “Orbiter” drone downed yesterday afternoon, Sept. 20, over the Strait of Hormuz by Iran's Army.
text:
🔆🔅Images show the Israeli “Orbiter” drone downed yesterday afternoon, Sept. 20, over the Strait of Hormuz by Iran's Army."

"🔺 Advanced Orbiter reconnaissance drone destroyed over the Strait of Hormuz"

"🔹 Iran’s Army Public Relations: An advanced Orbiter reconnaissance drone was struck and destroyed over the Strait of Hormuz by fire from the Army Air Defense Force’s indigenous systems, within the country’s integrated air defense network, in the southeastern region of the country."

"Source: Iran’s State TV
